item.title: John Mellencamp Announces 2026 "Dancing Words" Greatest Hits Tour
item.description: John Mellencamp has revealed his 2026 "Dancing Words" tour. The 19-city US summer trek features greatest hits and deep cuts not performed in over a decade.

item.title: Rock Fest Reveals 2026 Lineup with Gojira, Limp Bizkit, and The Offspring
item.description: The lineup has been announced for the 2026 edition of Rock Fest in Cadott, Wisconsin, featuring headliners Gojira, Limp Bizkit, and The Offspring.

item.title: Zendaya and Friends Are All Grown Up in Euphoria Season 3 Trailer
item.description: The Emmy-winning drama returns this April on HBO and HBO Max.

item.title: Avatar Announce Spring 2026 US Tour
item.description: Avatar have announced a Spring 2026 US tour with Fleshgod Apocalypse and Frozen Soul. See the dates and learn how to get tickets.

item.title: Anderson .Paak Reveals First Trailer for Heartwarming Directorial Debut K-Pops!
item.description: The dramedy, which premiered at the 2024 Toronto International Film Festival, will hit theaters this February.

item.title: Robyn Says She Hated Elon Musk "Way Before It Was Cool"
item.description: Robyn explained why she hated Elon Musk long before it was cool and slammed the "tacky" billionaire space race during a recent podcast appearance.

item.title: An AI Artist Has Three Songs in Spotify's Viral 50
item.description: The AI account Sienna Rose has placed three songs on Spotify's Viral 50 -- USA playlist, with one track seemingly fooling Selena Gomez.

item.title: Trailer for Paul McCartney Documentary Man on the Run Captures His Posts Beatles-Era
item.description: Man on the Run chronicles Paul McCartney's life after The Beatles and before Wings. The Morgan Neville-directed film premieres on Prime Video on February 27th.

item.title: The Casualties Return with "People Over Power," First Original Song in Eight Years
item.description: The Casualties have released their first original song in eight years, "People Over Power." Stream the track.

item.title: J. Cole Announces New Album THE FALL-OFF Arriving in February
item.description: J. Cole has announced his long-awaited album, THE FALL-OFF, will be released on February 6th and shared the artwork.
